items.name: DeRay Davis
items.caption:
The Hip Hop Squares host behind Netflix’s How to Act Black is back on the stand-up circuit.
DeRay Davis performs at Houston Improv on December 17, 2026. He has also appeared in Barbershop and 21 Jump Street. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
